name: Banana Island Incremental
desc:
A satisfying banana collection game 🍌
The more you rebirth and ascend, the more bananas you'll collect!

[🌳] Watch bananas drop automatically!
[🏭] Use the Banana Processor to turn bananas into coins!
[⚡] Upgrade for faster growth!
[🎲] Discover 50 rare banana types!

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a Like and Favorite!
📅 More updates and content coming soon!

🛠️ Beta: Features may change, and bugs may appear.

scripts.title: Discover all Bananas
scripts.script:
local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.PlayerDataService.DiscoverBanana
local allBananas = {
"AmethystBanana", "AngelicBanana", "Banana", "BigBanana", "BlackHoleBanana",
"BronzeBanana", "ButterflyBanana", "CashBanana", "CoinBanana", "CrystalBanana",
"CursedBanana", "DiamondBanana", "DiceBanana", "EmeraldBanana", "FireBanana",
"FishBanana", "FlowerBanana", "GalaxyBanana", "GlitchBanana", "GoldBanana",
"GraniteBanana", "GrassyBanana", "HolographicBanana", "IceBanana", "LaserBanana",
"LeafyBanana", "LightBanana", "LightningBanana", "MagmaBanana", "MusicNoteBanana",
"NebulaBanana", "NeonBlueBanana", "NeonGoldBanana", "NeonPinkBanana", "ObsidianBanana",
"OverRipeBanana", "PlasmaBanana", "PrismaticBanana", "QuantumBanana", "RainbowBanana",
"RedRibbonBanana", "RiddlerBanana", "RubyBanana", "SandyBanana", "SapphireBanana",
"ShadowBanana", "SilverBanana", "UnderRipeBanana", "VoidBanana", "WaterBanana"
}
for _, bananaName in ipairs(allBananas) do
remote:InvokeServer(bananaName)
print("Discovered: " .. bananaName)
end
